question: Which of the following statements is true about the changing pattern of India’s international trade?

options.text: The share of agriculture and allied products has declined, whereas, shares of petroleum and crude products and other commodities have increased.
The share of agriculture and allied products has increased, whereas, shares of petroleum and crude products and other commodities have declined.
The share of agriculture and allied products has varied, whereas, shares of petroleum and crude products and other commodities have remained constant.
The share of agriculture and allied products has remained constant, whereas, shares of petroleum and crude products and other commodities have fluctuated

solution:
The correct answer is __**The share of agriculture and allied products has declined, whereas, shares of petroleum and crude products and other commodities have increased. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The share of agriculture and allied products in India's international trade has declined, while the share of petroleum, crude products, and other commodities has increased i**s correct
 
• **Agriculture and Allied Products**:
 
 
• Over the past few decades, **the share of agriculture and allied products in India’s international trade has generally decreased**.
 
• This is because **India has been focusing more on industrialization, services, and manufactured goods for exports rather than just relying on agricultural commodities**.
 
 
 
• **Petroleum and Crude Products**:
 
 
• On the other hand, **the share of petroleum and crude products has increased significantly. **
 
• **India has been a major exporter of refined petroleum products d**ue to its well-developed petroleum refining sector.
 
 
 
• **Other Commodities**:
 
 
• Similarly, **other commodities like electronics, chemicals, and engineering goods have seen an upward trend in exports**.
 
• These sectors have gained importance as India diversifies its export basket.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's **international trade includes the import and export of goods and services**.
 
• India's trade **has grown significantly over the years, and the country is a major exporter of goods and services.**
 
• India's top** export destinations include the United States, United Arab Emirates, Netherlands, China, and Bangladesh**
 
• **India's top exports include refined petroleum, diamonds, packaged medicaments, jewelry, and rice **
 
• The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) is responsible for formulating and implementing India's Foreign Trade Policy
 
• The DGFT provides educational videos to help traders and newcomers set up import-export enterprises
